About Obby: Death Run

RUN. JUMP. DODGE. SURVIVE. Three levels of pure platforming chaos. Traps are everywhere — moving platforms, lasers, hammers, spikes. One wrong move and youre back to the start. Only you can finish it all. ‍ LEVEL 1 — SIMPLE A few traps to warm up. Learn the rhythm. Find your flow. LEVEL 2 — MEDIUM The traps get smarter. Faster. Deadlier. So must you. LEVEL 3 — HARD Everything at once. Lasers, hammers, spikes, moving platforms. REWARDS AWAIT YOU: • Collect skins and trails in each level • Earn exclusive skins at the end of every level Can you survive all three levels? The traps are waiting. The challenge is calling!
